note: used = session + recorded facet bytes + namespace images; an admitted operation (write, fill, image) evicts the oldest images other than the one written until it fits, and is refused with ENOSPC, changing nothing, when it would not fit with all of them gone; reservations count in used and are never evicted: reserve is admitted like a write, a draw takes what its reservation covers without admission and admits only the rest, refund moves bytes from the session back to the reservation, release/releaseAll/restart drop reservations
